quote: also lets centralize all decisions each as its own standalone like AIPs, we call them D-1, D-2 etc. they also need to have a fully automatic maintenance / reflection step that can supersede old decisions or a group of old decisions so we always have a view of recently up to date decisions, that still hold true, and are never outdated
means: Each decision is a standalone doc D-n. Every new decision runs the reflection: it records which earlier decisions it supersedes, in whole or in part; which decisions still hold is computed, never edited.

reflection.checked: every decision before D-15 that held
